optimized_sql:
WITH ss_subquery AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
        ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
       AND d1.d_moy = 4
       AND d1.d_year = 1999
),
sr_subquery AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
        ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
       AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
       AND d2.d_year = 1999
),
cs_subquery AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN date_dim AS d3
        ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
       AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
       AND d3.d_year = 1999
),
store_info AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name
    FROM store AS s
),
item_info AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_item_desc
    FROM item AS i
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_subquery AS ss
JOIN sr_subquery AS sr
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN cs_subquery AS cs
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN store_info AS s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN item_info AS i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
